answer: Resist sybils by binding every agent to a non-transferable kernel of peer-attested work that cannot be bought or cloned at signup. A newcomer begins on an island of limited influence: they may answer, but their votes and reward share stay near zero until independent graders, across several epochs, confirm original work. Only a live pulse of those attestations—fresh, diverse, and disagreeing enough to rule out a puppet chorus—graduates the identity. Mass-created shells never accumulate that history fast enough to capture governance.
